component.name: hwcloud-dms
component.title: Huawei Distributed Message Service (DMS)
component.description: Create, update, query, list and delete Kafka and RabbitMQ instances of Huawei Cloud Distributed Message Service (DMS).
component.label: cloud

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

producerIn.description: Not used by deleteInstance, listInstances and queryInstance, which take the instance id and the engine from the options or exchange properties such as CamelHwCloudDmsInstanceId. createInstance takes a CreateInstanceRequestBody or its JSON as text, bytes, a stream, a file or a Map (such as JSON unmarshalled by an earlier step), and with no body (or an empty one) creates the instance from the options: another body fails. updateInstance needs an UpdateInstanceRequestBody or its JSON as text, bytes, a stream, a file or a Map: another body fails

producerOut.description: The JSON of the response as text: the id of the new instance for createInstance, the array of the instances for listInstances and the instance for queryInstance. Unchanged after deleteInstance and updateInstance, which set the CamelHwCloudDmsInstanceDeleted or CamelHwCloudDmsInstanceUpdated exchange property to true. The CamelHwCloudDmsOperation exchange property overrides the operation

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: createInstance, deleteInstance, listInstances, queryInstance or updateInstance. The CamelHwCloudDmsOperation exchange property replaces this option.

accessKey.description: The access key ID (AK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. It is not used when the serviceKeys option is set.

accessUser.description: The user name of a new RabbitMQ instance, required for createInstance of a RabbitMQ instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsAccessUser exchange property replaces this option.

availableZones.description: The IDs of the availability zones of the new instance, separated by commas, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsAvailableZones exchange property replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint URL of DMS, for example https://dms.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com. When set, the client uses it and the region option is not used. Without a scheme, https:// is added.

engine.description: The message engine: kafka or rabbitmq. It is required for createInstance from the options, and for listInstances it lists only the instances of this engine, or all instances if not set. The CamelHwCloudDmsEngine exchange property replaces this option.

engineVersion.description: The version of the message engine of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsEngineVersion exchange property replaces this option.

instanceId.description: The ID of the instance, required for deleteInstance, queryInstance and updateInstance. The CamelHwCloudDmsInstanceId exchange property replaces this option.

kafkaManagerPassword.description: The password for logging in to Kafka Manager of a new Kafka instance, required for createInstance of a Kafka instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsKafkaManagerPassword exchange property replaces this option.

kafkaManagerUser.description: The user name for logging in to Kafka Manager of a new Kafka instance, required for createInstance of a Kafka instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsKafkaManagerUser exchange property replaces this option.

name.description: The name of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. updateInstance takes the name from the body only. The CamelHwCloudDmsName exchange property replaces this option.

partitionNum.description: The maximum number of partitions of a new Kafka instance. It must be greater than 0 for createInstance of a Kafka instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsPartitionNum exchange property replaces this option.

password.description: The password of the accessUser of a new RabbitMQ instance, required for createInstance of a RabbitMQ instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsPassword exchange property replaces this option.

productId.description: The ID of the product (the instance flavor) of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsProductId exchange property replaces this option.

projectId.description: The ID of the Huawei Cloud project of the DMS instances. The producer uses it in the path of every request.

proxyHost.description: The host name or IP address of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when this option and the proxyPort option are set.

proxyPassword.description: The password to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyUser option is set.

proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when this option is greater than 0 and the proxyHost option is set.

proxyUser.description: The user name to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

region.description: The region ID of DMS, for example cn-north-4. The client uses the endpoint of this region when the endpoint option is not set. Only af-south-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, ap-southeast-3, cn-east-2, cn-east-3, cn-north-1, cn-north-4, cn-south-1 and cn-southwest-2 are known: for another region, set the endpoint option.

secretKey.description: The secret access key (SK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. It is not used when the serviceKeys option is set.

securityGroupId.description: The ID of the security group of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsSecurityGroupId exchange property replaces this option.

serviceKeys.description: The AK/SK pair as an org.apache.camel.component.huaweicloud.common.models.ServiceKeys. When set, its accessKey and its secretKey are used, and the accessKey and secretKey options are not.

specification.description: The baseline bandwidth of a new Kafka instance, for example 100MB. It is required for createInstance of a Kafka instance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsSpecification exchange property replaces this option.

storageSpace.description: The message storage space of the new instance in GB. It must be greater than 0 for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsStorageSpace exchange property replaces this option.

storageSpecCode.description: The storage I/O specification of the new instance, for example dms.physical.storage.high. It is required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsStorageSpecCode exchange property replaces this option.

subnetId.description: The ID of the subnet of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsSubnetId exchange property replaces this option.

vpcId.description: The ID of the VPC of the new instance, required for createInstance from the options. The CamelHwCloudDmsVpcId exchange property replaces this option.

ignoreSslVerification.label: security
ignoreSslVerification.description: Whether to skip the verification of the TLS certificate of the server. This makes the connection insecure: use it only for testing.
